# Definition Highlight

Component ID: definition-highlight

## Purpose and selection

- 澄清一个术语的定义、相邻概念与边界。

Do not use:

- 不适合完整过程、公式推导或连续模拟；机制用 cause-effect-chain，分层关系用 concept-layers。
- This is a text-led treatment: not a measured chart, real screenshot, spatial camera or continuous simulation.

## Supported inputs

- title: One content-specific heading, at most 24 characters.
- items: 2–4 label::detail entries separated by |; each field at most 24 characters. 各项服务同一个术语；定义不循环解释，例子和例外不能冒充定义。
- highlight: A real integer pointing to an existing item; it marks the final emphasis, not an inferred metric.
- note: One qualifier or source note, at most 40 characters. Retain uncertainty and evidence limitations.

}
~~~

## Reading order and motion

- 提出术语
- 解释定义和易混淆概念
- 落到区别或适用边界

Pattern: kinetic-type. Native default duration: 8s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### step-1

- Target: .vc-item:nth-child(1)
- Visible action: Explain supplied item 1 in narration order
- Authored start: 1.2s; action duration: 0.5s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured phrase introducing this item, never its text-length estimate.

- Target: .vc-item:nth-child(4)

### resolve

- Target: .vc-item
- Visible action: Restore the complete readable relationship
- Authored start: 6.6s; action duration: 0.55s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the concluding phrase that resolves the shown relationship.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe; never truncate or shrink text.
- missingInput: Report the missing real content or evidence; do not substitute demo defaults.
- timingMismatch: Bind every active event to measured narration while preserving order, nonoverlap and a readable final hold.
- inapplicable: Choose another proven native recipe. Under recipes-only policy report the capability gap; do not create custom graphics.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
